conclusion.required_runner_adaptation: Keep text/header generation on hybrid; call the existing crystal method with mode=ar for the body. The current generate helper passes one mode to both, so split those two calls at the runner layer.
conclusion.recommended_control_policy: Use greedy_argmax for AR body tokens to match the frozen CF evaluator's greedy_argmax token selection. This deliberately changes the stock AR body sampler, which is multinomial at temperature 0.8.
conclusion.claim_boundary: This is a same-checkpoint decoder control. It does not turn the frozen CF result into an AR result or establish a separately trained pure-AR model.

checkpoint.checkpoint_access_note: Receipt and status were read locally; no SSH or remote checkpoint access was performed.

training_to_inference_alignment.clean_ar_training_targets: On hybrid crystal examples, the auxiliary crystal_ar group predicts clean crystal body tokens plus END, excludes PAD, and uses weight 1.0. AR target queries are at start-1 through the position before each target, so the first body token is predicted from the START token.
training_to_inference_alignment.training_time_embedding: The clean stream receives timestep 0; the shared timestep embedding table is zero-initialized before training and its learned row 0 is used at inference for existing crystal-body context.
training_to_inference_alignment.attention_and_positions: Clean-stream query rows remain causal, with ordinary contiguous position IDs. The AR inference path uses the same causal attention and positions.
training_to_inference_alignment.next_token_alignment: prediction_positions applies an offset of one for mode=ar. crystal(mode=ar) reads the last input position's logits before appending each next token.

generation_path.task_prefixes: G/E tasks provide a prompt prefix; text(..., trigger=true) greedily generates the lead/header ending with CRYSTAL_START; crystal then receives prefix+lead. E's prefix includes the earlier reference crystal and its END.
generation_path.body_decoder: The existing crystal(mode=ar) branch recomputes logits over context+generated body for each of at most K=2560 tokens. It bans all tokenizer special IDs except END and PAD.
generation_path.cache: hidden() calls the base model with use_cache=false; no KV cache is used.
generation_path.termination: AR body decoding stops on END, appends PAD through K, then unpack_block requires exactly one END, no PAD before END, and only PAD after END. It rejects missing END or malformed PAD boundaries.
generation_path.stock_sampler: The existing AR body branch samples multinomially at temperature 0.8. Replacing that choice with argmax is the only additional decoding-policy change proposed to match the frozen CF token selection.

reload_requirements.reason: restore_checkpoint strictly checks checkpoint configuration and strict-loads the state. A default block_size=K constructor would fail the B8 check.
reload_requirements.reuse_note: The B8 evaluator wrapper configures block size 8. The frozen B32 evaluator loader hard-codes block_size=32 and must not be used unadapted.

fairness_and_interpretation: Use identical G/E task prefixes, direction, and hybrid-generated headers if the intended comparison isolates body decoding; keep Q/text behavior on the frozen hybrid path.
The body decoder changes from B8 confidence-one diffusion commits to left-to-right causal AR. This is the intended inference-mechanism contrast; the checkpoint weights and input cases remain shared.

AR appends PAD after END without predicting it, while CF evaluates the END/PAD sequence. Report body validity separately from boundary handling; AR boundary success is not evidence that the clean-AR loss learned PAD.

For the frozen CF evaluator, confidence-one commits use greedy_argmax token selection and deterministic confidence-based release. Greedy AR matches token selection but not the diffusion order or context.
